conflicting_normative_claims.claim: Gate 0 validates Projection identity and Gate 0 failure must not call DP

reproducible_conflict.premise_1: Projection identity cannot be deterministically checked before a ProjectionAST exists.
reproducible_conflict.premise_2: Storyboard/Video coherence cannot be checked before both views are derived from that ProjectionAST.
reproducible_conflict.premise_3: DP cannot run when Gate 0 fails, so DP cannot be the creator of an object that Gate 0 is required to validate first.
reproducible_conflict.conclusion: No execution order satisfies all v3.0 clauses. Treating the diagram as informal would silently select one old clause over another and violates the fail-closed authority rule.

alternatives_considered.rejected_because: It makes Projection identity and dual-view coherence uncheckable at Gate 0, or forces Gate 0 to validate a non-canonical placeholder.

alternatives_considered.option: Let DP create or repair ProjectionAST
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: It gives DP visual-design and deterministic artifact authority, violating Director sovereignty and local runtime ownership.

alternatives_considered.option: Treat ProjectionAST as a post-DP output while deriving views earlier
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: It creates two visual sources of truth and breaks canonical ProjectionAST identity.

selected_order: StoryboardProjection and VideoProjection from that same ProjectionAST
Gate 0 validates VEC, projection identity, dual-view coherence, security, and freshness
Fresh independent DP receives only the Gate-0-bound ReviewPacket
decision.revision_semantics: A RevisionRequest is locally validated, supersedes the candidate for acceptance without mutation, and invalidates from the earliest eligible Director-owned stage. It cannot create or modify ProjectionAST.

successor_authority.completeness_check: The successor contains the single order in its decision, data-flow diagram, Projection/Gate/DP contract, state graph, invalidation rules, work-package table, traceability matrix, and completion definition.

release_ledger_rebase_scope.reason: All prior completed records bind the v3.0 architecture SHA and their acceptance proof depends on a contradictory execution order. Historical Evidence is retained under invalidated_records, never deleted or counted as v3.1 completion.

invariants_preserved: Director remains the sole visual design authority
per-Shot 15-second capability limit and one CinematicShot per GenerationUnit remain intact
Storyboard and Video remain same-ProjectionAST derivations
v4 remains the sole production entry and production switch remains false
A10 owner preview approval remains user-only
verification_requirements: ReleaseControl must reject v3.1 active-guidance or architecture-hash drift before next/claim.
ReleaseControl rebase must bind this conflict Evidence path and hash to the v3.1 rebase record.
A7/A8 regressions must prove Gate 0 consumes an existing ProjectionBundle, failed Gate 0 does not invoke DP, DP receives a Gate-0-bound packet, and text never claims media acceptance.
All prior v3.0 completion records must be invalidated before the rebase; no manual state mutation is valid.
